caption: The loop runs one way: a click in the view dispatches an action, the pure reducer returns a new state object, and the store tells subscribers to re-render. The first dispatch in the worked example leaves count 1 and total 60.

spec.title: The Redux one-way loop
spec.aria: A four-box loop: the React view dispatches an action to a pure reducer, which produces a new store state with count 1 and total 60, and the store notifies the view to re-render.
